edges.detail: The scheduler consumes the active-object vector in native order.
Local semantic orders become owned simulation command admissions.
Dock/credit closure depends on canonical resource overlay identity and amount state.
Dock unloading depends on resource value, cargo capacity, and conversion authority.
Refinery docking uses the shared radio contact protocol.
Refinery docking consumes generic queue/reservation authority.
Signed vitality update hands fatal results to death/destruction consequences.
Death consequences produce explosion, debris, and transient effect presentation.
Death and impact consequences route gameplay sound triggers.
Object reveal/conceal updates mutate persisted per-cell map knowledge.
Persisted map knowledge drives tactical shroud composition.
Per-cell knowledge feeds radar availability and minimap visibility policy.
Radar policy and events are consumed by minimap terrain/object/shroud pixels.
Radar availability is gated by the house power state.
Power output/drain and low-power state feed sidebar power presentation.
Power-state transitions produce EVA feedback.
A delivered unit enters movement admission and blocked-exit recovery.
Capture mission completion hands the building to ownership-transfer consequences.
Load restoration must reconstruct active-object membership and ordering before the next tick.
Launching the selected stock map depends on retail asset resolution and MIX precedence.
The accepted map must decode before scenario construction can begin.
The first playable frame depends on native-compatible scenario object construction order.
Drive locomotion consumes an admitted destination and cell-entry decision.
Drive locomotion needs a path with native tie-breaking and reconstruction semantics.
Each accepted step must commit occupancy and layer transitions in native order.
Armor, warhead, Verses, and type authority must be resolved before the damage kernel can match native semantics.
The selected closed loop reaches damage through projectile collision, fuse, and detonation authority.
Area-target collection, ordering, and falloff determine which receivers enter the kernel.
Foundation acceptance consumes land, slope, overlay, and buildability state before placement commits.
Foundation acceptance depends on blocker, occupancy, and reservation state.
Accepted placement must create, reveal, and register the building without splitting lifecycle authority.
Exit handling starts from a completed object owned by the correct factory queue.
Clear, blocked, and retried exits depend on authoritative cell occupancy.
A delivered unit must enter movement admission without duplication or loss.
Capture execution depends on native approach admission when the engineer starts outside capture range.
The player-visible loop is not closed until power, tech, radar, and production ownership effects transfer.
The capturing engineer's removal and the building's continued identity use shared lifecycle authority.
Reveal mutation consumes the object's native sight range and footprint.
Elevation, cliff, bridge, and building reference frames shape the reveal footprint.
The protocol must mutate the canonical per-cell knowledge state consumed by tactical and radar rendering.
Boarding and deploy handoffs consume the shared contact/radio protocol.
Passengers need approach admission and valid exit destinations for the closed loop.
Boarding and unloading must limbo/unlimbo passengers without duplicate active membership.
Nuclear launch depends on house-owned super runtime identity and charge-state authority.
The nuclear state machine hands off through native projectile creation and bookkeeping.
The player-visible blast is incomplete without native damage and fatal handoff semantics.
Restoration can only be correct for state serialized under the native class/version contracts.
Object references must be swizzled before post-load fixups and resume.
Resume depends on reconstructing active-object membership and deterministic order.
The selected outage fixture begins with authoritative sell/refund/teardown effects.
The replacement producer must enter its live construction presentation, but native power authority begins while buildup remains active rather than after it finishes.
The replacement power producer must pass and commit stock placement before power can recover.
Active-YR generic sidebar chrome loading consumes the faction-side MIX resolver installed before SidebarClass::LoadSHPs.
The production sidebar atlas resolves verified generic roles and SIDEBAR.PAL through immutable side-1/side-2 routes while leaving Yuri radar/background on sidec02md and RADARYURI.PAL.
